title: Israeli Drone Strikes Gaza Funeral Procession, Killing 8 Mourners
detail: An Israeli drone struck a funeral procession outside the Ahmad Yassin Mosque in the Nuseirat refugee camp on July 17, 2026, killing at least 8 mourners and wounding 20 others as they gathered to bury a Palestinian killed hours earlier in a separate strike in the same area. The Israeli military said it had targeted a Palestinian Islamic Jihad cell, and said it was 'aware of the claims that several uninvolved individuals were harmed as a result of the strike.' Israeli attacks across the Gaza Strip killed at least 14 Palestinians that day, more than half of them in the funeral strike, part of a wave of ceasefire violations documented by the UN, which recorded 10 separate Israeli attacks across Gaza City, central Gaza, northern Gaza, and Khan Younis on July 17–18 alone, killing at least 21 people.
